descriptionHtml:
Bug B17 · P1 · new

Errors show the raw server message to the physician ('[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] … Server Error … 404')

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-94425 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94423): counted on TC-13/S28 (the physician sees the raw error, TFA-94745). The provider text a vision failure forwards to the browser (OAT-05/S30) is now suggestion A6. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745): a failed dictation recovery shows the raw Convex error too (usePreRoundAudioRecovery.ts:227, useAudioBackup.ts:95; OAT-03/S19, TC-23/S25).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-13/S28

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S19 Voice transcription fails: connect retried, a dropped session recovered from the kept audio, a clear message only if that fails

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 A failure during voice transcription: transcription retries automatically; the audio is kept until transcription succeeds; if it still fails, a clear message shows and the dictation isn't lost (UAT OAT-03 step 7; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 4; TFA-94745 AC 4)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style (TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 1)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given A browser or phone with a real microphone; Hospital pre-round dictation and a Nursing Home visit dictation

When (a) the transcription service is unreachable when Dictate starts; (b) the connection drops after ~20 s of speech; (c) it stays down until the recovery transcription has also failed

Then (a) one quiet reconnect ('Preparing dictation…'), then a clear message; nothing lost. (b) the recording is kept and transcribed once the connection is back, and the words appear in the field. (c) a clear message, the recording is still waiting for recovery and can be recovered later; no text dictated before the drop is lost

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester compares the field text with the script word by word; any missing words before the drop = Fail. Record the speech-to-text engine per attempt from the transcribe.prepareSession / transcribe.transcribeAudio diagnostics rows (3.9); a whisper-1 recovery in (b) is recorded and judged against Q16

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
